decisions.reason: The combined shuttering/de-shuttering robot extends the firm's core automation offering, and one year on the market is too short to judge it against aspirations, so the firm has no performance shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
The automatic de-shuttering robot fits the firm's strategic push toward automated precast production, and its R&D-intensive engineering slack lets it carry the product while results remain uncertain.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots within integrated plant solutions, so dropping it would weaken the coordinated offering at little resource gain.
The automatic shuttering robot builds directly on established capabilities and the automation strategy, and no evidence of underperformance calls for problemistic search or withdrawal.
